summary: Curry County, OR L-5 lookout cab built 1934 on the Siskiyou NF, abandoned in 1954 and gone; no source read describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1954 and gone, per the Former Fire Lookout Sites register

events.note: L-5 cab constructed on the site
Panorama photos taken by Sarlin on April 6, 1934; the register credits the National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
Registered November 18, 2019 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register; nominated by Tammy McLeod

evidence.supports: L-5 cab constructed on the site in 1934
evidence.quote: A L-5 cab was constructed on the site in 1934.

evidence.supports: panorama view from the lookout dated April 6, 1934 by Sarlin

evidence.supports: panorama photos credited to the National Archives Pacific Northwest Region

The lookout was abandoned in 1954 and is gone.

notes_for_editor: The 1934 build date and the 1954 abandonment agree across the register, firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts. The register and firelookout.com both say the site is gone. No visit report, access rule or photo URL was found in the sources read, so the story says nothing about the site today beyond that. The brief's record matches; 'abandoned 1954' was missing from its events and is added here. The Sarlin panoramas are dated 4-6-1934 by the register and April 6, 1934 by the ORWW index.
